sourceFile: 80.BRS-161014 Report checking and test process solder date 8.12.2023_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft mixes several unrelated solder investigations into one changed factor and maps key defect rates incorrectly.
issues: Changed factor combines lot, pad clean, plasma, drying, AWF, shift, and tip conditions.
Baseline/test conditions are not comparable across dates, lots, machines, and process settings.
Pair subresults use re-spot sample counts as input instead of production input/NG rate.
Night shift and AWF metrics are separate descriptive tables, not evidence for the same comparison.
Evidence list includes rows without shown context and omits needed headers for defect columns.
requiredUserQuestions: Should this file be split into separate cases for pad cleaning/plasma, AWF machine checks, and tip changes?
correctionPlan: Split review cases by one primary changed factor and preserve date/lot/machine subgroups.
Rebuild baseline/test pairs only within comparable E2/F-PCB lot and process contexts.
Use production input, total NG, NG rate, and after-repair NG rate from the correct columns.
Keep night shift and AWF summaries as separate outcomes only if tied to a defined comparison.
Cite header rows plus every compared data row for each corrected outcome.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but grouping and column mapping are insufficient for final evidence.
